title: Procurement signal synthesis for regulated edge verticals — cross-region model scouting
creator: Priya Nambiar
description:
Context:
Many mid-market and enterprise customers in regulated verticals (healthcare, finance, telco edge) require predictable procurement signals before committing to Dedicated or Private deployments. Existing model-landscape trackers surface capability and latency, but we lack a unified signal synthesis that maps vendor/model availability, quantization/compatibility risk, regional latency economics, and procurement triggers specific to edge/regulatory constraints.

Goal:
Produce a repeatable playbook and data pipeline that converts raw market signals (model releases, quantization support, regional capacity availability, licensing terms, performance microbenchmarks) into procurement-ready alerts and a prioritized candidate list for edge/regional reserved capacity pilots. The output should be actionable for Solutions Engineering and GTM to trigger contract conversations or Dedicated sizing.

Scope / Non-goals:
- In scope: cross-regional signal taxonomy, prioritized scout list, telemetry queries for cost/latency signals, prototype dashboard wireframe, 2 pilot customer playbooks (healthcare EU, telco APAC).
- Out of scope: procurement contract drafting, on-prem installation automation (handled by Private infra team).
acceptance_criteria: Signal taxonomy document covering at least 8 signal types (availability, quantization, SLA, latency economics, licensing, telemetry cadence, reliability incidents, regional footprint)
Prototype 1-pager that maps signals to procurement triggers with threshold examples for low/medium/high risk
Automated query templates (BigQuery/Dataplane) that return regional availability + latency delta for top 10 candidate models
List of 12 prioritized model-region pairs with recommended provisioning path (hosted -> dedicated -> private)
Pilot playbooks for two regulated vertical customers with explicit success metrics
deliverables: Signal taxonomy markdown (Drive link in attachments)
Wireframe for 'Edge Scout' dashboard in Console
Two customer pilot playbooks and runbooks

2026-03-06 - Design sync: DES-204 scoped for a single dashboard screen and drilldown. Need ENG metrics endpoint for regional availability before wireframes can be finalized. (Sophie)
2026-03-08 - Infra update: ENG-22111 will expose a 'region-model-availability' view; ETA 2026-03-18. This is a critical path for queries. (Evan)

2026-03-10 - Decision: For initial pilot we will weight licensing restriction signals higher for regulated verticals (e.g., data residency clauses). Added licensing scoring to taxonomy. Next: build procurement trigger matrix. (Mateo)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: early thresholds will favor false positives (more procurement conversations) rather than false negatives for regulated customers because missing a shortage risks deal loss. We will iterate thresholds based on pilot outcomes.
risks: Regional telemetry incompleteness leading to noisy scores
Model vendors changing licensing rapidly (requires frequent re-ingest)
ENG endpoint slip could delay pilot by 3+ weeks
